transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you for having me. I, um, I hope I'm not taking up too much of your time. 

I'm just here because... well, I don't want to make a big fuss out of nothing, but I just feel like I got this, like, a motor running inside me all day long. I try real hard to just be good and stay quiet, but if I have to sit still—like at church, or out there in your waiting room, or even just at home—I get this feeling like I'm trapped. I just... I have to get up or do something, you know? 

I hope that's an okay reason to be here. Does... does that make sense?
Do you often have trouble paying attention, even when you want to focus?

Well, I... I try really hard to pay attention, I promise I do. I don't want you to think I'm ignoring people on purpose or being rude. But, um... sometimes when folks are talking to me about important things—like when we're trying to figure out ride times, or making lists for the pantry, or even going over plans for church—I listen real good right at the start. 

But then... I don't know, my mind just kind of slips off somewhere else. I don't mean for it to happen, but suddenly I realize I missed pieces that I really needed to hear. I feel terrible when I have to ask them to repeat it. Is... is that the kind of thing you mean? I hope I'm answering your question right.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually high, euphoric, or on top of the world?

Oh, no, sir. I've never felt anything like that. I mean, I have good days, of course—days where I'm in a fine mood and thankful for my blessings. But I've never felt, um, unusually high or anything extreme like that. I always try to stay grounded and humble, you know? I hope that's a good thing. I wouldn't want you to think I was acting out of line or getting too big for my britches. Does that sound like a normal answer?
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about many different things, even when there isn’t a clear reason to?

Well, um, I wouldn't say I worry a lot, exactly. I mean, I care about things, and I want to make sure I'm doing right by folks. I might fret a little bit over, you know, making sure the house is tidy or if I said the wrong thing to somebody at the store. But I don't think it's anything too out of the ordinary. 

I try really hard to just trust in the Lord and let things be. I don't want to sound like a complainer or like I'm making mountains out of molehills. Most folks worry a little bit, right? I hope that's not something bad I'm doing.
Do you remember having these same problems with sitting still or paying attention when you were a child?

Well, I... I guess I did have a little trouble back then, yes sir. I don't want to make it sound like I was a bad kid or anything! I always wanted to be good. But, um... back when I was a boy in school, the teachers... well, they were always having to move my seat around. 

I just had the hardest time staying put, and sometimes I'd talk out of turn without meaning to. I'd get so eager, I'd just jump right up before class was even done. I got in a bit of trouble for it, which always made me feel awful. I really did try to behave, I promise. Do you... do you think that means something's wrong with me, or is it normal for little boys to be a bit squirmy like that?
Do these problems with sitting still or paying attention make it hard for you to manage your daily responsibilities?

Well... I hate to admit it, sir. I try my absolute best to be helpful, I really do. I don't want you to think I'm lazy or irresponsible. But... I guess it does make things a bit hard. 

I feel awful even saying it, but... well, folks at the church, and down at the food pantry, and even my own family... they've kind of stopped trusting me with things. Like, um, giving folks rides, or keeping track of appointments, or handling the supplies. I always mean to help out, my heart is truly in the right place, but I just get so wound up or lose track of what I'm doing, and then I mess it up. 

I feel like I just keep letting everybody down, even when I'm trying so hard to do right by them. I hope you don't think too poorly of me for that. I really do want to be a reliable person, you know? Does that make sense to you?
